# Book Search

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Query book by title, author, publisher, or ISBN, and get book information via Google Books API for properties.

## Scope note

Simplifies creation of Book notes by downloading relevant properties and cover image.

## Broader

- [Obsidian Plugin](../ObsidianPlugin/)
